definitions.explanation: A written or spoken assessment of a product, service, book, movie, or other item. Widely used for online user reviews and professional evaluations.

examples.japanese: {購入|こうにゅう}{前|まえ}にレビューを{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the reviews before buying.

examples.japanese: このレストランはレビューの{評価|ひょうか}が{高|たか}いので、{予約|よやく}が{取|と}りにくい。
examples.english: This restaurant has high review ratings, so it's hard to get a reservation.

notes:
レビュー is a loanword from English "review" and is primarily used for evaluative assessments, especially online.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レビューを{書|か}く (write a review)
- レビューを{読|よ}む (read reviews)
- レビューを{確認|かくにん}する (check reviews)
- レビュー{評価|ひょうか} (review rating)
- ユーザーレビュー (user review)
- {口|くち}コミレビュー (word-of-mouth review)
- {星|ほし}{五|ご}つのレビュー (five-star review)

USAGE NOTES:
- In Japanese, {口|くち}コミ (word of mouth) is sometimes used interchangeably with レビュー for online reviews
- In business and academic contexts, レビュー can also mean a formal review process: コードレビュー (code review), {論文|ろんぶん}レビュー (paper review)
- The native Japanese word {批評|ひひょう} covers formal literary or art criticism
